plugins.name: japanese-reply
plugins.description: Keeps Claude Code replies in Japanese. / Claude Code の返答を日本語に保つフック

plugins.name: concise-report
plugins.description: Blocks a reply that is too long and asks for a short, results-only report. / 返答が長すぎたら止めて、結果だけの短い報告に書き直させるフック

plugins.name: verified-fix
plugins.description: Requires a verified fact behind every "I fixed it". / 「直しました」と報告するなら、同じ条件で確かめた事実を書かせるフック

plugins.name: block-destructive
plugins.description: Denies DB deletion, git push --force, direct edits on production and similar commands before they run. / DB の削除・git push --force・本番の直接編集などを実行前に止めるフック
